import { AutocompleteRoot, type AutocompleteRootEmits, type AutocompleteRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { AutocompleteAnchor, type ComboboxAnchorProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<ComboboxAnchorProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteAnchor
    data-slot="autocomplete-anchor"
    class="sigma-ui-autocomplete-anchor"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </AutocompleteAnchor>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-autocomplete-anchor {
  width: 16rem;
}
</style>

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-input {

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { ComboboxContentEmits, ComboboxContentProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { AutocompleteContent, AutocompletePortal, AutocompleteViewport, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ComboboxContentProps>(), {
  position: 'popper',
  align: 'center',
  sideOffset: 4,
  collisionPadding: 8,
});
const emits = defineEmits<ComboboxContentEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompletePortal>
    <AutocompleteContent
      data-slot="autocomplete-list"
      class="sigma-ui-autocomplete-list"
      v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
      :class="[$attrs.class]"
    >
      <AutocompleteViewport>
        <slot />
      </AutocompleteViewport>
    </AutocompleteContent>
  </AutocompletePortal>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-autocomplete-list {
  z-index: 50;
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: var(--reka-combobox-trigger-width);
  min-width: 8rem;
  max-height: min(var(--reka-combobox-content-available-height, 18rem), 18rem);
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--popover);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--backdrop-filter-blur));
  color: var(--popover-foreground);
  outline: none;
  transform-origin: var(--reka-combobox-content-transform-origin);
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-list[data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-autocomplete-in 150ms ease-out;
}

.sigma-ui-autocomplete-list[data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-autocomplete-out 150ms ease-in;
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-autocomplete-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-autocomplete-out {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
</style>
